name: hotel-revenue-pacing-report
title: 酒店收入节奏报告
description: Use this skill when a hotel revenue manager, director of revenue management, or general manager needs to draft a weekly or monthly revenue pacing analysis report. Covers occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, pacing vs. budget and prior year, segment performance, competitive set benchmarking, forward-demand review, and pricing strategy recommendations. Produces a DRAFT report for revenue manager review before distribution to ownership or leadership.
